title_en: A Food Blogger Checks Out a Restaurant
note_en: After verbs of perception, 起来 means "when you (smell/taste/look at) it": 麻婆豆腐闻起来很香，尝起来又麻又辣 "the mapo tofu smelled wonderful and tasted numbing and spicy." English simply uses "smell," "taste" or "look" plus an adjective, but Chinese needs 起来 to turn the action into an impression: 看起来红红的 "looked bright red."
